title: Rules and regulations.
bodyText: The attorney general shall adopt rules and regulations, as may be necessary, which will insure compliance with the provisions of this chapter by the most efficient and effective means possible.
bodyHtml: §846-15  Rules and regulations.  The attorney general shall adopt rules and regulations, as may be necessary, which will insure compliance with the provisions of this chapter by the most efficient and effective means possible. [L 1979, c 129, pt of §2]
